items.summary: CFO recommendation: approve containment and reject all new spend, budget commitments, revenue forecasts, ROI claims, margin claims, and monetization expansion. The only revenue evidence is $4.92 Amazon commission for 2026-09-21, entirely in an aggregate provider row; site-attributed revenue is $0. September AI spend was $1,002.46 across 5,531 calls, so portfolio contribution margin is not calculable because the revenue and cost windows do not match and infrastructure, domain, labor, and other operating costs are absent. Cost-to-learn is also not calculable because no per-change cost allocation, control delta, or validated outcome value exists. Minimum measurement is same-period per-change AI and infrastructure cost, registered affiliate clicks, ordered and shipped items, commission, and treatment/control outcome deltas. Retain only the existing capacity-gated work; reject the duplicate repair item and do not create a finance proposal or telemetry request.
